blocks.value: An **expression** is a construct made up of variables and operators that evaluates to a single value.
`11 + 13` is an expression. So is `x = 12`. Expressions can also return other types of value, such as boolean or String.

11 + 13              // evaluates to 24
x = 12               // evaluates to 12 (and assigns it)
score > 50           // evaluates to true or false
"Hi " + name         // evaluates to a String
The key idea: an expression **is** its value. Anywhere Java expects a value, you can write an expression that produces one.
